releaseNotes.summary: Juno v0.4.2 Beta — Performance & Polish. Task-aware tool exposure cut reported input tokens by about 80.5% in the matched Phase 1 short-turn benchmark, the compact installer is smaller, startup/readiness improved on the tested host, and optional runtimes, Code validation and browser cleanup were tightened. Unsigned installer; updates are manual.
highlights: About 80.5% fewer reported input tokens in the matched Phase 1 short-turn benchmark; this is benchmark-specific, not a universal per-task or per-provider claim.
Compact installer reduced from 271.7 MB to 252.3 MB.
Faster startup and renderer readiness on the tested Windows host, with shell, first-transcript and composer-ready marks.
Modular optional Android platform tools and cloudflared, with pinned versions, sizes and SHA-256 verification.
Capability selection during onboarding and a unified Runtimes & storage surface in Settings.
improvements: Code Mode validates requested content against the staged workspace, not only file existence.
A verified but unapplied change stays staged; apply records completion, while discard, rollback or failed validation is reported honestly.
Browser sessions have session-scoped close tools; the model cannot close your browser or another application's browser.
Installer identity is checked before and after packaging and before installation.
Codex ChatGPT-plan subscription routing and exact model pins remain unchanged.
Codex, Boreal/OMP and CUA remain bundled; they are not optional downloads.
fixes: Council reports the ordinary turn's exact executor model instead of routing a second, unused guess.
A closed browser session is settled even when it never performed an action, so it cannot leave an agent-owned session behind.
Cancellation and app exit release owned browser sessions.
A negative mention such as 'do not change README.md' no longer authorizes that file as a writable target.
A file named only to run is treated as an input, not an editable target.
knownIssues: The Windows installers are unsigned. Windows may show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen, and some managed PCs may block them.
Updates are manual. The signed automatic-installer upgrade path is not qualified; the feed only announces a release and opens the release page.
A workspace-wide spending hard cap remains unenforceable across some external provider routes.
Boreal/OMP and CUA remain resident; there is no automatic safe idle retirement.
Android device control, live microphone capture and a public remote-access tunnel remain hardware-, account- or consent-bound.
External providers require their own valid accounts, subscriptions and quota.

The rebuilt full/offline installer was identity-verified and smoke-tested from the same qualified source on the isolated test identity; a fresh production-identity full NSIS registration was not repeated because no disposable Windows profile or VM was available.
releaseNotes.compatibility: Windows 11 x64. Existing v0.4.1 profiles upgrade in place with this manual installer. The public v0.4.1 installer remains available for manual rollback; back up local data first. Rollback compatibility is not promised for future schema versions.
